As the episode "[[Padawan Lost]]" takes place between the two episodes according to {{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-clone-wars-chronological-episodeorder|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Chronological Episode Order}}, Dar's [[death]] must take place in that [[Standard year|year]]. [[Wasskah]]{{TCW|Padawan Lost}} |species=[[Trandoshan]] |gender=[[Gender|Male]] |pronouns=He/him{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/padawan-lost-episode-gallery|text="Padawan Lost" Episode Gallery}} |height=1.98 [[meter]]s {{C|6 [[Foot|ft]], 6 in}} |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes=[[Color|Yellow]] |skin=Yellow |cyber= |families=new |parents=[[Garnac]] |partners=new |siblings=new |children=new |affiliation=[[Garnac's hunting guild]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|Not so impressive, are you? And yet, you have the honor of being my first Jedi kill. First of many, I hope.|Dar, to Kalifa|}} '''Dar''' was a [[Trandoshan]] [[Gender|male]] who was the son of [[Garnac]], the leader of a [[Garnac's hunting guild|hunting guild]] that [[Hunting|hunted]] both [[Sentience|sentient]] and non-sentient prey on the [[moon]] of [[Wasskah]]. During the [[Standard year|year]] [[20 BBY]], Dar was on the verge of becoming an official member of the guild. When the guild hunter [[Lo-Taren]] captured the [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano]], Garnac believed that Dar's first trophy had been acquired. Two [[Standard day|days]] after Tano's capture, Dar was inducted into the guild by his [[Parent|father]] and led the following day's hunting expedition. Dar quickly caught onto Tano and the young Trandoshan chased the Padawan and her Jedi [[youngling]] companion [[Kalifa]] through the [[jungle]]s of one of Wasskah's [[Island Four|islands]]. However, the inexperienced Dar was foiled by a mixture of his targets' agility and the jungle's terrain. After a failed offense against Tano, Dar tumbled into a gully and was [[Death|impaled]] on a stone spike. Believing the Jedi to be solely responsible, Garnac executed Kalifa and swore vengeance on Tano. Garnac's campaign to avenge his son ended when Garnac himself was defeated by Tano days later during a [[Battle on Wasskah|conflict]] that destroyed almost the entire hunting guild. ==Biography== ===Hunting heir=== {{Quote|Are you ready, young Dar?|Garnac|}} Dar was a [[Trandoshan]] [[Gender|male]] born to the Trandoshan [[Garnac]], the leader of a [[Garnac's hunting guild|hunting guild]] based on the [[moon]] of [[Wasskah]].{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/padawan-lost-episode-guide|text="Padawan Lost" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}} Despite not being a member of the guild, Dar nonetheless hung around the guild's [[Ubrikkian Floating Fortress]].The source book ''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]'' identifies the guild's base as a [[Ubrikkian Floating Fortress]]. However, it was his [[Parent|father's]] intention to eventually bring Dar into the guild's fold. As it happened, the guild was known to kidnap both [[Sentience|sentient]] and non-sentient prey from across [[the galaxy]] that was then brought back to Wasskah to be hunted down for sport. Among the Trandoshans' [[prisoner]]s were [[Jedi]] [[youngling]]s, who were considered by the guild to be valuable targets. For Dar, killing a Jedi was an important right of passage. ===Induction as a hunter=== {{Quote|Your son will outplay all comers.|Lo-Taren, to Garnac|{{TCW|Wookiee Hunt}}}} [[File:Krix_Lagon_Garnac_and_Dar.png|thumb|left|250px|Dar alongside his father on the guild's freighter]] In the [[Standard year|year]] [[20 BBY]], Dar was set to be inducted into the guild as an official member. Several [[Standard day|days]] before his induction ceremony, Dar accompanied his father on the guild's [[HCT-2001 Dragonboat-class Reugeot 905 freighter|Trandoshan prisoner ship]] for a galactic hunt that saw the captures of various individuals. Eventually, the [[pilot]]s [[Krix]] and [[Lagon]] brought the [[Starship|ship]] to the [[planet]] [[Felucia]]. By this time, the [[freighter]]'s cargo bay held four prisoners, including the [[Selkath]] [[Morgo]], the [[Sakiyan]] [[Vadoo]], the [[Terrelian Jango Jumper]] [[Lika]], and the [[Snivvian]] [[Katt Mol]]. Upon landing on Felucia's surface, the hunter [[Lo-Taren]] disembarked alone to find potential prey. When Lo-Taren returned, he had the Jedi [[Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano]] in tow, having captured her while she participated in a [[Second Battle of Felucia|battle]] being fought as a part of the on-going [[Clone Wars]] conflict between the [[Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Lo-Taren eagerly conveyed his thoughts on the capture to Dar and Garnac, in which he believed that Tano would make for an exceptional hunting experience. Garnac agreed, and Dar planned to make Tano his debut hunt's first trophy. The Trandoshans returned to Wasskah and dropped the prisoners they had captured on the [[jungle]]-covered [[Island Four]]. Dar watched from the freighter's [[cockpit]] as Lo-Taren used the ship's weapons to [[Death|gun down]] two of the prisoners and force the rest into the jungle. The next day, Dar was present in the fortress trophy room when Garnac announced the beginning of a new hunting period. The hunters cheered as they took up arms and rode down to Island Four on [[MSP80 Pteropter hover pod|MSP80 hover pods]]. Dar himself participated in the hunt by piloting Lagon's hover pod, although Lagon took over when the pair were later joined by Garnac. At some point during the hunt, Dar, Garnac, and Lagon overheard Lo-Taren calling for backup. After a day of hunting, during which at least two more trophies were claimed, the Trandoshans reconvened in the trophy room for Dar's initiation ceremony. Dar's peers chanted and hooted in celebration as Dar stepped towards Garnac and was officially made a member of the guild. His first hunt began the following morning. ===First hunt=== {{Quote|Finish her, my son. The ''kill'' is yours."
"I will kill her with my own hands.|Garnac sends Dar after Kalifa|}} For Dar's first hunt, the young Trandoshan was given the chance to lead the expedition. Two hover pods were taken to the surface, one solo piloted by the hunter [[Sochek]], and one piloted by Lagon with Dar and Garnac as passengers. Upon hitting the ground, it was discovered that Tano had allied herself with three other Jedi younglings that had been captured sometime prior: [[O-Mer]], [[Jinx]], and [[Kalifa]]. The pods gave chase, with Sochek herding O-Mer and Jinx away from Tano and Kalifa. Dar's pod continued to chase Tano through the jungle until they had successfully separated her from Kalifa. With Kalifa cut-off from Tano, Garnac urged Dar to proceed on foot and kill her. Dar jumped from the hover pod and gave chase. He managed to corner Kalifa, but was caught by off-guard and thrown against a [[tree]] with Kalifa's [[Force push|use]] of [[the Force]]. However, having taken a fall earlier, Kalifa was exhausted by the time Dar caught up to her again. The young Trandoshan gloated over the idea of making Kalifa his first Jedi kill and took aim with his [[sniper rifle]]. Before he could shoot, Tano dropped from a nearby tree and knocked Dar onto his back. Dar responded by shooting at both Jedi, but was unable to land any killing shots. ====Death==== [[File:DarsDeath-PL.png|thumb|right|300px|Dar was killed during his first hunt.]] Frustrated, Dar resorted to attacking Tano directly, and the two engaged in [[Unarmed combat|hand-to-hand combat]]. The two traded blows, taking turns punching, kicking, and tackling each other. The agile Jedi was able to avoid several of Dar's more lumbering attacks, leading Dar to rush her head on in a final act of desperation. The Trandoshan tackled Tano, but having thrown too much force into the endeavor, he over-rolled and unintentionally released Tano before careening over a boulder and into a gully. Dar landed on a rocky spike, ending the young hunter's life on his debut hunt before he could bag even one kill. ===Legacy=== {{Quote|You murdered my son, and you need to ''pay'' for what you ''did''."
"Your son died because of your own actions, ''not mine''.|Garnac and Ahsoka Tano|}} Dar's death enraged Garnac into a frenzy. The Trandoshan swiftly killed Kalifa with a well-aimed [[blaster]] shot and swore vengeance on Tano. Garnac swept the island for Tano, but failed to relocate her. Eventually, the Jedi managed to contact [[Wookiee]] [[soldier]]s and directly attacked the guild's fortress. Garnac personally dueled Tano in the trophy room and was beaten, after a lengthy brawl. Garnac continued to blame Tano for Dar's death, but Tano retorted that Garnac's eagerness to send his son into the hunt was to blame instead. Un-accepting of the accusation, Garnac reached for a [[blaster rifle]], only for Tano to throw Garnac out of the trophy room and over the outside balcony in an act of self-defense. The guild was dismantled, and its survivors fled Wasskah.{{TCW|Friends and Enemies}} ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|She will die by my claw!|Dar expresses enthusiasm towards hunting Ahsoka Tano|}} [[File:Dars_Sniper_Rifle.png|thumb|left|275px|Dar takes aim with his rifle]] Raised as an ambitious hunter, Dar was eager for the hunt. Garnac cherished his son, and in turn Dar looked to please his father, boldly stating his desire to personally kill a Jedi target when Garnac brought up the topic. Openly optimistic, Dar would often celebrate declarations regarding the guild's hunting activities, such as when Garnac expressed interest in making Tano Dar's first trophy or when Garnac announced the beginning of a new hunt. During his guild induction ceremony, Dar played the part of a triumphant warrior, roaring and cheering alongside his comrades. Dar even traded several chest bumps with his peers as he stepped forward to be inducted by his father. For Dar's first and final hunt, he was entrusted with leading the charge, and the young hunter appeared to enjoy the hover pod chase. Dar was confident in his abilities to fight the Jedi—which he referred to as "whelps"—on foot, but after failing to kill Kalifa with his hands, he resorted to using his rifle. Upon cornering Kalifa he found her to be less than impressive, but hoped to maker her the first of many Jedi trophies nevertheless. He considered the idea of turning Kalifa into a trophy to be an honor on her part. Dar proved to be fast—if inaccurate—shooter, as after being knocked down by Tano he quickly popped back up to continue the fight. However, Dar's inability to kill the Jedi frustrated him, causing him to forgo his weapons and fight Tano in personal combat. Dar's subsequent attacks proved to be unfocused, as he wildly swung at the Jedi, landing only a few blows. After being tackled by Tano, Dar attempted a similar maneuver, but he put more force into the move than he needed which led to his demise. Physically, Dar was a Trandoshan male who stood at 1.98 [[meter]]s (6 [[Foot|feet]], 6 inches) tall and featured a lean build comparable to his father. Dar's scales were a [[Color|yellow]] color, and the young Trandoshan exhibited yellow [[eye]]s. ==Skills and abilities== Dar was young and inexperienced Trandoshan hunter but was still capable in both armed and unarmed combat. His tracking and survival skills enabled him to chase after and corner Kalifa but was caught by off-guard and thrown against a tree with Kalifa's use of the Force. The young Trandoshan was also skilled with a sniper gun, taking aim at Kalifa, whom he hoped to make his first Jedi kill. However, his lack of experience caught up to him and before he could shoot, Ahsoka Tano dropped from a nearby tree and knocked Dar onto his back. Despite his knowledge of hand-to-hand combat, Dar's inexperience caused him to lose his fight against Tano, plunging to his death. ==Equipment== During his first and final hunt, Dar's weapon of choice was a black, long-barreled sniper rifle with a vertical foregrip, a sling, and a scope. After failing to shoot his quarry with the rifle, Dar attempted to use the rifle as a club and subsequently lost hold of the weapon. Dar was also had access to and was capable of piloting the guild's hover pods. Dar's [[Clothing|fatigues]] consisted of a reddish-brown t-shirt, a gray vest with yellow shoulders, gray shorts and anklets, and [[gauntlet]]s on both [[Limb|wrists]]. Dar also wore a cartridge carrier on his left arm along with a red armband on his right arm. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|Garnac came from George, Lo-Taren came from George, young Dar came from George. Those were all names that were created at the writers' room.|''The Clone Wars'' series lead [[Dave Filoni]] discusses the naming of Lo-Taren|[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Three|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Three]]}} [[File:Dar_Concept_Art.png|thumb|right|250px|Conceptual artwork of Dar for "Padawan Lost"]] Dar was created for the animated series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', with his only appearance being in the episode "[[Padawan Lost]]" as a supporting character. The twenty-first episode of the show's [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]], "Padawan Lost" aired on [[April 1]], [[2011]].''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]'' Dar was subsequently mentioned in the following episode, "[[Wookiee Hunt]]," where his death served as the driving force behind the antagonist's motives. Dar's voice was provided by [[Kevin Thoms]]. Like all of the Trandoshans that appeared in "Padawan Lost" and "Wookiee Hunt," Dar was designed by conceptual artist [[Pat Presley]]. ''[[Star Wars]]'' creator [[George Lucas]] created Dar's name during a writing session for the show.[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Three|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Three]] ==Appearances== *{{TCW|Padawan Lost}} {{1st}} *{{TCW|Wookiee Hunt}} {{Mo}} ==Sources== *{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode321.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Padawan Lost}} *[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Three|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Three]] *{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/padawan-lost-episode-guide|text="Padawan Lost" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}} *{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/wookiee-hunt-episode-guide|text="Wookiee Hunt" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}} *{{SWCT|set=Base Series 1|cardname=Chewbacca - Kashyyyk Warrior}} {{Imo}} *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Character Encyclopedia - Join the Battle!]]'' *{{EncyclopediaCite|Anakin Skywalker}} {{Po}} *{{Databank|garnac|Garnac}} *{{Databank|trandoshan|Trandoshan}} ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Dar}} {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Dar |ja=ダー }} [[Category:Garnac's hunting guild members]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Trandoshans]]
